{{Field procedure|summary=Use a Detailed Surface Scanner to map a planetary ring and reveal mining hotspots that can guide commodity targeting.}}

Use this procedure when a commander has reached a ringed body and needs to reveal mining hotspot markers before choosing where to begin a mining run.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you start ==

* Fit and power a [[Detailed Surface Scanner]].
* Travel to a system with a body that has [[Planetary Rings|planetary rings]].
* Leave supercruise travel time and fuel for moving between ringed bodies if the first candidate is not useful.
* Decide whether the goal is simply to learn the process or to look for a specific mined commodity.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Enter supercruise in the target system and select the ringed body.
# Approach until the Detailed Surface Scanner can be used on the body and its rings.
# Open the Detailed Surface Scanner interface.
# Fire probes so the ring is mapped rather than only the main body surface.
# Wait for the scan result and review any hotspot markers that appear in the ring.
# Select a hotspot marker that matches the intended mining plan, or record that the ring is not useful for this run.
# If no suitable hotspot appears, check another ringed body or continue with ordinary prospecting if the run does not require a hotspot.
}}

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when hotspot markers are visible for the ring, or when the commander has confirmed that the scanned ring does not provide a useful hotspot for the current plan.

== Common problems ==

* '''Only the planet was mapped:''' make sure probes are being placed to cover the ring area, not just the body surface.
* '''No hotspot appears:''' not every ring provides the hotspot a commander wants; move to another ring or change the plan.
* '''The hotspot is visible but far away:''' select it as a navigation target and approach in supercruise before dropping into the ring.
* '''The hotspot name looks profitable but the market is stale:''' a hotspot helps find material, but selling still depends on current demand and price data.
